A 28-year-old IT employee who travelled nearly 2,000 kilometres to Delhi to meet a YouTuber and social media influencer died after allegedly being assaulted by her family members and neighbours when he tried to enter her house in east Delhi’s Madhu Vihar, police sources said on Thursday (November 19, 2026).
The deceased, identified as Abhinav, was a native of eastern Uttar Pradesh and worked with an IT company in Chennai. He succumbed to his injuries on November 14, a week after the alleged assault.
The incident took place on November 7, when Abhinav allegedly tried to enter the woman’s house by jumping over its boundary wall, triggering a confrontation with her family members and neighbours. He was then beaten up during the altercation and sustained grievous injuries.
The investigation revealed that Abhinav had come in contact with the woman through Instagram and regularly liked her photographs and videos. The influencer posts travel and lifestyle content and has over 2.8 million followers on YouTube and around 643,000 followers on Instagram.
According to police sources, Abhinav had travelled to Delhi around two months earlier and met the woman. “The influencer thought he was a fan and agreed to meet him. However, he had developed one-sided feelings for her. On learning that she was due to get married later this year, he travelled to Delhi again on November 7 and tried to enter her house by jumping over the boundary wall,” a police source familiar with the investigation said.
During questioning, the woman told the police that she did not know Abhinav personally and had assumed he was among the many fans who regularly sent her messages on social media. The police suspect that Abhinav had identified her residence by watching her videos.
Following the assault, Abhinav was taken to Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital, where doctors referred him to Guru Teg Bahadur Hospital after finding his condition critical. He was subsequently shifted to Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital as his condition failed to improve. He died while undergoing treatment on November 14, the source said.
The Madhu Vihar police initially registered an FIR under Section 110 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which deals with attempting to commit culpable homicide. Following his death, the section was changed to Section 105 of the BNS, pertaining to culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
The woman’s father and a neighbour, who were seen assaulting Abhinav in CCTV footage, have been arrested and are currently in judicial custody.
The police are examining CCTV footage from cameras installed at and around the scene to identify other suspects and establish their roles in the assault. Further investigation is underway.
